sample_size: Between-player group n=22 across 17 tournaments (repeated observations); within-player subgroup n=12 (>=8 tournaments each). Observations clustered/repeated across tournaments. Time-point means (pre/post-travel/post-tournament, W): 7,855 +/- 860 | 7,580 +/- 600 | 7,246 +/- 496.
adjusted: no (descriptive; opposition/finishing-position covariate adjustment applied only to GPS running outcomes)
note: Recovery-intervention confounding: posttravel recovery session (30-40 min, light skills, low-intensity small-sided game, flexibility, hydrotherapy), compression garments and sleep/nutrition advice during travel; posttournament recovery practices (nutrition, hydrotherapy, cryotherapy, compression, sleep) uncontrolled.
